statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). The value r is the least positive integer n whose decimal representation contains at least one digit equal to some element of nums1 and at least one digit equal to some element of nums2; the same digit may witness both conditions if it occurs in both arrays. Equivalently: if nums1 and nums2 have a common digit, then r is the smallest digit occurring in both arrays; if they have no common digit, then r = 10*m + s, where m = min(min(nums1), min(nums2)), and s = min(nums2) when m occurs in nums1, while s = min(nums1) when m occurs in nums2.
